question: Does preserving separate writer coefficients at the two subject-onset destinations predict row-level reader magnitude that a summed writer coefficient misses?

authority.scalar_compiler_terminal: wrong_predictor: behavioral execution passes but heldout magnitude correlation fails

novelty: v3 summed the two exact destination writes and separated fit/heldout by intervention orientation. This test changes both identified weaknesses prospectively: destination-resolved features and lexical-group holdout containing both orientations.

frozen_design.population: A1 group pairs alternate between fit and heldout, retaining both directions in each; all A2 transfers; aligned P controls
frozen_design.writer_features: one uncentered A1-fit SVD coefficient for each of the two 128-dimensional destination-specific source-term vectors
frozen_design.reader_targets: rank-one A1-fit coefficients for block9 H1/H4 and block11 H3
frozen_design.target_model: two independent affine maps from two destination coefficients to each reader coefficient: six fitted scalars
frozen_design.baseline_model: the v3-style summed writer coefficient with two affine maps, refitted on the same balanced split: four fitted scalars

predictions.pred_a_exact_writer_interface: direct source-term reconstruction equals fixed-source writer within 1e-4 on all splits
predictions.pred_b_destination_magnitude_prediction: both target coefficient correlations have absolute r>=0.60 on heldout A1 and A2
predictions.pred_c_destination_resolution_beats_sum: mean absolute heldout coefficient correlation exceeds the same-split summed baseline by >=0.15
predictions.pred_d_destination_program_material: destination-predicted program retains >=0.65 of full response and is donorward on >=0.75 of heldout/A2 rows
predictions.pred_e_aligned_p_selective: target program absolute normalized P effect <=0.20
predictions.pred_f_price_exact: 41 forwards, 1008 examples, 288 unique records, ten total fit scalars, 768 axis coordinates, zero backwards/updates

terminal_rules.invalid: authority, balanced split, writer closure, coverage, finiteness, or price fails
terminal_rules.writer_summary_insufficient: valid test but destination features do not improve magnitude prediction
terminal_rules.behavioral_null: coefficients correlate but the installed response is not materially causal

interpretation_limits: This tests whether destination separation is the missing causal state, not arbitrary higher-rank regression.
Failure redirects coefficient prediction to reader-local background state rather than more writer-only dimensions.
C selectivity remains inherited because C cannot instantiate the aligned writer interface.
